description: Roll a budget Constraint up (BL-11): total of stated contributions vs the limit, the worst dependency path among contributors (the path-cumulative rollup — end-to-end latency, mass down a chain), basis coverage (estimated vs measured), and an honest verdict — `incomplete` when any contribution is unstated, because a partial sum passed off as a total is how budgets lie. Contributors with no stated number are listed, never zeroed. The verdict reads the declared `composition` (sum or path); `judged_on` and `composition_note` name which. Omit `constraint_id` to read them all at once. Ask for this when you want to know whether a declared limit or allowance is being exceeded — a budget for latency, mass, cost or any quantity — and which contributors take it over.

budget_chars.description:
How many characters the all-at-once reply may spend (default 30,000). Counts are never
trimmed. Ignored when `constraint_id` is given.
